title: Marbling
description: Ink marbling floating on moving water, in two traditions. Each drop is a closed loop that displaces every existing drop by the exact area-preserving map p → C + (p−C)·√(1 + r²/d²), pushing earlier colours into thin shells; a divergence-free curl flow swirls the whole bath like liquid. Choose Suminagashi (Japanese) for muted indigo/charcoal rings floated from a wandering source and barely combed, or Ebru (Turkish) for vivid inks raked into a nonpareil weave with occasional stylised flowers. Drag to rake a comb, click to drop a stone; tradition, drop rate, water flow, comb, ink opacity and palette are live and audio-mappable.
